```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE)

library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(chromote)
library(purrr)
library(glue)
library(gt)
library(magrittr)
library(ggpubr)
library(zoo)

```


```{r list_of_items, echo=FALSE , message=FALSE}

list_of_items <- c("vial_water","dragon_bones","blankrune","naturerune" ,
                   "irit_leaf","3dose1energy","3dose2energy","iron_knife",
                   "avantoe","harralander","gold_bar","emerald",
                   "ring_of_dueling_8","ranarr_weed","kwuarm","mcannonball",
                   "iron_ore","coal","iron_bar","steel_bar",
                   "yew_logs" , "chocolate_dust","mortmyremushroom","eye_of_newt",
                   "lantadyme","dwarf_weed","cadantine","amulet_of_glory_4",
                   "dragonhide_green", "dragonhide_blue","unidentified_guam")
```


```{r funksjon}
plot_list = list()

for(i in 1:length(list_of_items)){
  item_name = list_of_items[i] 
  
  files_in_folder <- list.files(glue("PRICE_DATA/{item_name}/")) 
  
  list_item_df = list()
  for(j in 1:length(files_in_folder)){
    list_item_df[[j]] = readRDS(glue("PRICE_DATA/{item_name}/{files_in_folder[j]}"))
  }
  alle_item_dfs <- bind_rows(list_item_df, .id = "column_label") %>% 
    arrange(desc(date)) %>% 
    select(-column_label) 
  
  p <- ggplot(alle_item_dfs) +
  geom_point( aes(x = date, y = pris , size = antall) ) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = date, y = pris ),method='lm' , se = FALSE ) +
  # geom_line(aes(x = date, y =  rollmean(
  #   pris, 10, align = "right") )) + 
  ggtitle(glue("{item_name} price with\nlinear regression")) +
  ylab("GP PRICE") + 
  labs(size = "number of\nitems\ntraded")
  
  plot_list[[i]] = p
  
}

```



```{r plots1}
ggarrange(plot_list[[1]],plot_list[[2]],plot_list[[3]],plot_list[[4]])

```
